name: Offline Shoujo
source:
This is a doujin game by Chainsou. 

Nayuta lives with his mother in the not-too-distant Nipponbashi in Osaka while working on creating apps for smartphones. The Nipponbashi Street Festival (Sutofes) has had growing attendance over the years, but it has particularly garnered a lot of attention this year with the expansion of the underground shopping centre, being featured in the world’s premier internet company Eagle-sha’s real map web service Roadview and also being supported by the mayor. Nayuta and his friend Hajime went to the underground idol concert and met the idol Rikka, and he was charmed by her song. He also happened to met  a new system engineer from Eagle-sha, Chisato, with whom he had often chatted online.

While set in Den-Den Town, the focus of the game appears to be rather on family relations. Nayuta dropped out of school in order to help out his divorced mother. Chisato gave up everything she had to become an engineer in order to gain her parents’ love. Rikka was raised by a foster father and doesn’t know her true parents. 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/01/01/january-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
這是Chainsou的同人遊戲。

那由多和他的母親住在相距不遠的大阪日本橋，同時致力於為智慧型手機開發應用程式。日本橋街道節（Sutofes）多年來參加人數不斷增加，但今年隨著地下購物中心的擴建、世界頂級網際網路公司Eagle-sha的真實地圖網路服務Roadview的專題報導以及市長的支持，它尤其引起了廣泛關注。那由多和好友阿一去參加地下偶像演唱會，遇見了偶像六花，並被她的歌迷住了。他還碰巧認識了鷹社新來的系統工程師千里，兩人經常在網上聊天。

雖然故事發生在日本橋電電城，但遊戲的重點似乎是家庭關係。那由多為了幫助離婚的母親而輟學。千里為了贏得父母的愛，放棄了一切成為一名工程師。六花由養父撫養長大，不知道自己的親生父母。

［來自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/01/01/january-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]］
